eli (Partnerships): Quick pulse check: proposing a compact marketplace pricing play for cloud marketplace + HW partner bundles. Goal: fast POC traction, clear renewal expectations, and a tidy upgrade path to Dedicated. Thoughts?
mina (Sales): Short version: yes. Need clear commit floors so AE crediting maps to quota. Also want a conversion incentive.
eli (Partnerships): Draft structure: two-stage offer: "Intro" (90d) and "Commit" (12mo). No new SKUs; use marketplace flags and billing masks. Intro = 30% off list, $12k min commit, $2k onboarding credit. Commit = 18% off, 12mo true-up, HW rebate up to $8k redeemable only for Reserved/Dedicated capacity.
owen (Product): Ops note: any rebate redeemable for capacity must reference capacity SKU IDs so we can validate autoscale + billing mapping. UI should show "Intro price" and "Expected renewal" with tooltip.
tess (Finance): Financial rules: onboarding credits amortized over the committed term; Intro prepay recognized monthly. I'll run ARR impact and churn sensitivity. Also we should cap total redeemable credits per account.
rex (Solutions): SI piece: SI activation credit (one-off $1.5k) after integration checklist. Credits cannot stack; highest applicable credit applies. Require signed integration checklist within 45 days.
ops-bot: Reminder: staging checklist created: entitlement flag + pricing mask + billing-hook smoke tests (owner: ops).
mina (Sales): Renewal sweetener: if customer renews at >=110% of commit, extend Commit discount by 3ppt next year. Also if they convert to Dedicated within 6 months, give 50% of onboarding credit back as capacity credit.
eli (Partnerships): Runbook: T-5w assets drafted, T-3w LOA signed, T-2w SI enablement, T-1w legal signoff, announce. Action items: Eli finalize playbook (Tue), Tess ARR model (Thu), Rex SI checklist (Fri), Ops validate staging (Wed). Any objections? :rocket:
